raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the core purpose of a standardized taxonomic classification system. It incorrectly prioritized "geographical habitats" (Option B) as the primary function, conflating the utility of standardized naming for data aggregation with the actual definition of taxonomy. Taxonomy is fundamentally about creating a consistent, universal language (Option C) to define relationships and identities among organisms, not primarily to map their habitats. The Planner prematurely declared the task complete without verifying this fundamental biological concept or considering that Option C is the direct definition of why standardization is needed for determining relatedness.
